negative_findings_and_qualifications: MCP has installed SDK4MiB actual-byte and100-message limits before dispatch; no parsedBody bypass from Can.
No unauthenticated grant mint, token-hash bypass, public-export auth bypass or caller-appointed actor/team/now demonstrated.
Login rejects unverified email before creating session; grant route relying on that constructor is not an established unverified-user bypass.
Wrong PKCE/client/redirect refuses before code consume; valid43 succeeds. IP09 remains narrow44-character challenge mismatch.
Auth client-key headers are documented best-effort throttle input, never identity. Actual Cloudflare header provenance/platform resource limits unqualified.

Byte caps do not establish wall-clock/depth/node/aggregate concurrency budgets. Capped reader awaits cancellation without deadline; SDK overcap releases lock without cancel. Host stream termination not proved.
Safe FS keys block ordinary path traversal. Symlink escape requires local control of trusted root/key; production R2 unjoined. Fixed principal/counter doubles explicitly test-only.
Magic-only file detection deliberate, no complete image/PDF validation guarantee or new malware policy selected.
Unexpected public errors generic; embedded secret operator messages retained by documented keyed redaction. Trusted BusinessError safety belongs producer; no new public provider leak shown.
Account delete/disable, OAuth client retirement/refresh tokens and automatic identity sweep absent. No invented lifecycle/policy guarantee.
Per-method awaits/read checks do not imply atomic commit, current disclosure or physical erasure proof. State/CF broad review root-owned.
